text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Italian suits are exquisite after all.
...However, these are all rather "standard" choices.

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Welcome.
Are you looking for something?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"No, I merely dropped by on a whim.
I have a favorite tailor in Italy... and I suppose I simply missed it."

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that right!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
If I had to say...
I suppose I'm looking for something that gives me a spark.

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
In that case...
how about this jacket, for instance?
Please, feel free to take it in your hands and have a look.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
I will gladly take a look.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(A simple, proper design.
The quality seems high too, so it's not bad, but...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...W-Wait.
That lining is...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Vivid, brilliant multicolored artwork
you'd never imagine from its subdued exterior...!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
"It was designed by an up-and-coming Italian artist.
I felt it would perfectly suit your refined aura."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: (Ah... I completely let my guard down, assuming this jacket had an ordinary design.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: (She baited me into thinking she took the standard course... I was misdirected!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Unaware that it was merely a decoy
to maximize the impact of the lining.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: (A ruler demonstrates the "standard move", locking down the enemy's train of thought.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Slip into the blind spot in the meantime...
and in the final decisive moment,
strike from behind the foe intoxicated with certainty of victory—)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: (Devour the entire board!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Fufu... Fahaha, hahaha...! 
What a magnificent strategy!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: It is wonderful... I like it very much. Could I have the bill, please?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sparked by an unexpected turn of events, Rulership was hit with a new tactical epiphany.
His mind was sharper than ever right now!
